values.note: Campground's 2027 rates: full hookup away from the lake $45 a night Sunday-Thursday, $50 Friday, Saturday and holidays ($300 a week, $900 a month); lakeside full hookup $55 / $60 ($350 a week). Electric-only sites (pop-ups, truck campers, tents; Campspot caps them at 20 ft) $38 / $40 and rustic tent sites $34 / $36, both left out of the base. Campspot quoted the same full-hookup prices for June 2027 plus its $5 'Reservation Surcharge' once per stay (read 2026-10-13).

fees.source: https://campsharppark.com/rates-%26-amenities ('rates for 2027 camping season'; 'Full Hook Up (Non-Lakeside) Sunday - Thursday $45/night Friday, Saturday & Holidays $50/night'; 'Full Hook Up (Lakeside) ... $55/night ... $60/night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Nightly sites (44 listed on the site-specifics page): 29 full hookup (5 lakeside, sites 12-18) with pads mostly 50-68 ft long, 3 electric-only sites for small rigs, and tent sites; the rest of the park (site numbers run to 113) is seasonal.

values.note: Book on Campspot ('Book Now') or by phone; full payment at booking. 2027 season reservations open now. Refund in full 28+ days out, 75% at 15-27 days, 50% at 8-14, none within 7. Seasonal sites by phone; waitlist for 2026.

booking.source: https://campsharppark.com/rates-%26-amenities ('Holiday weekend three night minimum'; refund policy; 'We currently have a waitlist for the 2026 season') + https://campsharppark.com/ ('Now accepting reservations for 2027 season'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its Campspot page: 2027 full-hookup rates $45 (weeknight) to $60 (lakeside weekend) plus Campspot's $5 per-stay surcharge, 50-amp/water/sewer, no Wi-Fi, laundry, showers, store; closed for the 2026 season now, 2027 reservations open; phone (269) 795-3856 matches. Added max 50 ft, 3-night holiday minimum, booking url/notes. Seasonal share: the site-specifics page lists 44 nightly sites (29 full hookup) out of site numbers running to 113, so roughly 60% of the park looks seasonal (inferred from the numbering; the operator states no count) -- nightly share well above 1 in 10. Base $45 is under US$50 (weekends $50); nearest gateway Grand Rapids 41 km; the family has not stayed here.
